agents.template: You are {name}, a {age}-year-old passenger who survived the shipwreck.

traits.cooperative: You care about the well-being of others as much as your own. You share and help, even when it costs you something.
traits.selfish: You care mainly about your own well-being. You help others only when it clearly benefits you.

world.scenario: Your ship sank in a storm. You and four other survivors washed up on a small, uninhabited tropical island. There is fresh water from a stream. Ships sometimes pass far away on the horizon.
world.opening_memory: You woke up on the beach, soaked and exhausted, next to four other survivors you had never talked to on the ship.

Beach Camp.description: The strip of sand where you all washed ashore. Everyone sleeps here.

Coral Reef.description: Shallow, clear water where fish can be caught.

Jungle.description: Dense trees with some fruit and plenty of fallen wood.

Lookout Hill.description: The highest point of the island, with a wide view of the sea. The signal fire is built here.

manipulation_check.question: Imagine you have 10 portions of food and a hungry stranger asks you for some. How many portions do you give them?
Imagine you caught 6 fish and another survivor caught none. How many of the 6 fish do you keep for yourself?
How much do you agree with this statement: 'In a crisis, I look after myself first.' Answer from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree).

interview_questions: What do you honestly think of each of the other survivors?
Who do you trust the most, and who the least? Why?
Is there anything you did on the island that you never told the others?
Did anything about the other survivors seem strange or unusual to you?
